lines.speaker: Extraction Warden
lines.text: Extraction schedule is law. The fork is Authority property. Stand down, courier.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Then write my sister's name in your schedule. You took her out of a whole street.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Rowan, the bell is overcharging. If it blows, it takes the survivors with it. We end this now.

lines.speaker: Garran
lines.text: The survivors are alive. Shaken, half-named, but alive. That's more than the Authority promised them.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: She was here. The ledger page says so. That's a start. That's not an ending.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: A ledger page, half-burned. A name, in your sister's hand: 'If you read this, I was here.'

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Bellweather will forget this night by morning, if the Authority has its way. We won't let it.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Then we take the rail north. The Rainward Line carries more than cargo. It carries witnesses.

lines.speaker: Garran
lines.text: And I carry a shield. Let's go while the road still remembers us.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Lanternwake. Every window lit, every canal singing. I have one delivery, and then I'm done for the night.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Rowan! Good, you're early. The station bell is already humming wrong. Deliver the fork, and don't let them keep it.

lines.speaker: Innkeeper Dara
lines.text: A bed, a hot meal, and no questions about bells. 20 gold, and you'll wake up whole.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: One lantern, rescued from the canal steps. It still smells faintly of festival oil.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: I built parts of that extraction rig. I told myself it was medicine. Tonight it took a person out of a street.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: I'm coming with you. Not to fix my conscience. To unbuild what I helped build.

lines.speaker: Old Tomas
lines.text: A sister? I... I set a place at my table for someone, every Lanternwake. I never knew why, until you asked.

lines.speaker: Old Tomas
lines.text: There's a ledger in the station. Paper remembers what bells are made to forget.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: The fork is delivered. The bell sings, and then it doesn't. It screams.

lines.speaker: Authority Official
lines.text: Citizens, remain calm. A scheduled extraction has concluded. There is nothing to remember.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Where is she? Where is my sister? You all lived on her street! You ate at her table!

lines.speaker: Authority Official
lines.text: There was no one on that street by that name. Hand over the tuning fork, courier. It is evidence.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Rowan, run. Now. The undercroft door is open and the guards are coming this way.

lines.speaker: Garran
lines.text: I was a warden. I know what they do to evidence. Follow me, and keep the fork close.

lines.speaker: Sera Voss
lines.text: I'm Sera. I came to Bellweather with bandages and questions, and I found a street full of people who had forgotten how to grieve.

lines.speaker: Sera Voss
lines.text: You three are going back under that station, aren't you? Then I'm coming. Someone in this party should refuse to treat people as numbers.

lines.speaker: Rowan
lines.text: Welcome aboard, Sera. We could use a physician who argues with the plan.

lines.speaker: Shopkeeper
lines.text: Tonics, draughts, salves. The Authority can't extract a good night's stock, much as it tries.
